name: semafour-dotnet-debug
description: Lightweight .NET Core / ASP.NET Core debugger for VS Code powered by netcoredbg over the Debug Adapter Protocol.

program.description: Absolute path to the .dll to debug. Resolved automatically from the .csproj when omitted.

project.description: Path to the .csproj file. Defaults to the first .csproj found in the workspace folder.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debugged program. Defaults to the project directory.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the program. Takes precedence over values from launchSettings.json.

noDebug.description: Run the program without waiting for the debugger.

preLaunchTask.description: Name of a task to run before launching. When omitted, 'dotnet build' is run automatically.
